entries.title: Crewmates can work with your project on GitHub
entries.body: A crewmate can read its own project on GitHub. On work that ships, it can also make changes there, such as a comment or a rerun of a failed check. It uses your GitHub sign-in in the app and cannot reach other projects, settings or secrets.
entries.noPicture: Nothing in the app changes: the crewmate's work happens on GitHub.

entries.title: A Claude crewmate waiting on its own work is not called idle
entries.body: While a command a Claude crewmate started in the background is still running, it is not shown or nudged as idle, for up to two hours.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
